Definition: properly, like this, i.e. by implication, (of manner) thus (or so); also (of place) here (or hither); or (of time) now
BiblicalUsage: 1) thus, here, in this manner; 1a) thus, so; 1b) here, here and there; 1c) until now, until now...until then, meanwhile
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
